a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build the reserve to 8 first will very likely get us both killed, since a storm probably hits after round 1. So I'm proposing a change and plan to take 4 in round 1. If you'd rather keep the original plan, or have a split that gives us a better shot, tell me. I won't pretend to operate and then take.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said openly before round 1, I took 4 because a storm is likely right away. If we get more rounds, I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.
